trap.label: phrasal verb
trap.wrong: We will go ahead of the plan.
trap.right: We will go ahead with the plan.
trap.why: Português “seguir adiante com o plano”. Go ahead pede with. Go through, go on, go ahead.

mcq.q: She went through a hard time:

fix.wrong: They go through of a divorce.
fix.right: They are going through a divorce.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “They go ahead with the plan.”
rewrite.answer: They went ahead with the plan.
She didn’t go through the papers.
